internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all three occurrences hzm denotes one event: a massed military body is broken and routed. In 2:251 Talut's band 'routs them' (the enemy host) by God's leave; in 38:11 a 'host (jund) of the confederates' is described as 'routed (mahzum)'; in 54:45 'the assembly (al-jam`) will be routed and they will turn their backs.' The Quran supplies its own gloss of the event in 54:45 (turning the backs = flight) and, in 2:251, keeps hzm distinct from qatala (David's killing of Goliath), so hzm is the breaking-and-flight of the force, separable both from slaying and from the ensuing retreat. The only honest limitation is breadth: 3 tokens, all in a single battlefield domain.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: hzm does NOT entail killing or annihilation: 2:251 lexically separates hazamu (routing the host) from qatala (slaying the individual champion Goliath), and 54:45 construes the routed as alive and fleeing. It is NOT the fleeing itself: 54:45 uses a separate verb (wallu al-dubur) for the flight, making hzm the antecedent break, not the retreat. In the corpus it is never predicated of an individual, an object, a structure, or an abstraction — every bearer is a collective fighting body (-hum, jund, al-jam`); this is a distributional boundary at N=3, not a proven semantic exclusion. It is not tied to a single voice or tense (active past, stative participle, passive future) nor to human agency alone (2:251 credits it bi-idhni-llah).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The strongest adversarial reading is hzm = 'destroy/annihilate' (folding in the killing of 2:251). It is refuted Quran-internally: 2:251 deploys qatala separately for David's slaying of Goliath (redundant if hzm already meant 'kill them'), and 54:45 immediately unpacks the routed host as fleeing survivors (wa-yuwalluna al-dubur), not the dead. A second candidate, that mahzum (38:11) is a frozen lexicalized epithet split from the verbal event, also fails: it is predicated directly of jund 'there' (hunalika, battlefield deixis) 'of the confederates', i.e. it is transparently the resultative of the same routing verb applied to the same participant type. No occurrence supports 'destroy', and no occurrence resists the single-nucleus reading.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A generic military 'defeat / overcome' (with flight incidental), or a fully abstract 'break/shatter' with the military reading donated by context. Over these 3 same-domain tokens 'rout/put-to-flight' and 'defeat' are extensionally identical, so the boundary cannot be decisively drawn; the narrower 'rout/flight' account is preferred on two internal cues — the 54:45 self-gloss (yuwalluna al-dubur) and the 2:251 hzm/qatala split showing hzm targets force-cohesion, not casualties. The fully abstract 'break/shatter' is rejected as an over-abstraction that fits everything and adds no testable content (contract: prefer the narrowest account). This residual rout-vs-defeat under-determination is the genuine uncertainty capping the grade.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three independent lenses converge on one root nucleus with no resistant or lexicalized sub-class: the collective routing / putting-to-flight of a massed fighting body, distributed across active verb, passive verb, and maf`ul participle as ordinary Form I diathesis (not a semantic split). The evidence is adversarially clean and distinctiveness is shown Quran-internally (the qatala contrast in 2:251, the wallu al-dubur definition in 54:45). layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: Three Form I tokens, all with a collective fighting-body patient: 2:251:1:2 hazamu + -hum (active perfect), 38:11:4:1 mahzum predicated of jund (maf`ul participle), 54:45:1:2 yuhzamu with subject al-jam` (passive imperfect).
layer_attribution.derivation: One Form I nucleus across active verb, passive verb, and maf`ul passive participle; voice/tense alternation is ordinary Form I diathesis, not a semantic split. qac_verb_form is null for all three but surface strings are unambiguously Form I.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: No lexicalized/frozen sub-class: mahzum (38:11) is the resultative participle of the routing verb, transparently bridged to the verbal tokens by identical participant type and battlefield deixis (hunalika), not a detached epithet.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Narrative specifics — that the router is Talut's band, the routed are Goliath's/the confederates' host, the divine sanction bi-idhni-llah, and David's separate slaying of Goliath — are contextual and must NOT be read into the root; hzm's own contribution is the breaking-and-flight of the force, with agent identity and divine permission supplied by context.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: No reconciliation between competing dispositions was needed: all three lenses agreed on a single CONSISTENT nucleus with no override or resistant occurrence to reconcile.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No internal resistance. The sole unresolved matter is evidential, not resistant: at N=3 in one domain, 'rout/put-to-flight' cannot be decisively separated from generic 'defeat', and it is untestable whether the military/collective element is root-intrinsic or contextually donated — this caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence resists the single nucleus. The adversarially pressed candidates — reading mahzum (38:11) as a lexicalized epithet, and splitting human-agent rout (2:251) from divinely-caused passive rout (38:11, 54:45) — both fail Quran-internally: the participle is the resultative of the same verb on the same participant type, and the passive merely suppresses the agent while denoting the identical event. The only limitation is evidential breadth (N=3, one domain), not internal resistance.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quranic occurrence of hzm predicated of a non-collective or non-military bearer (an individual, an inanimate object, a structure, a debate, or an inner state), or one where hzm demonstrably entails killing/annihilation rather than a survivable rout, would break the 'rout of a massed fighting force' nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The three attested tokens 2:251:1:2, 38:11:4:1, 54:45:1:2 and any newly confirmed hzm occurrence; specifically the patient/subject of each (is it a collective jund/jam`/host or not) and the surrounding verbs (is killing bundled into hzm or held distinct as in 2:251's qatala).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Read verse_text and morphology for each hzm token; identify the entity acted upon and whether the stated consequence is flight (survivable rout, as 54:45 wa-yuwalluna al-dubur) or destruction; check whether any co-verb (qatala, wallu) is bundled into or separated from hzm.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Distinguish root-intrinsic meaning from contextual donation: at N=3 all bearers happen to be forces, so do not treat the military/collective element as proven root-intrinsic. Separate hzm proper from the flight verb (wallu al-dubur) and the slaying verb (qatala) that occur alongside it rather than folding them into hzm.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If a non-military/individual bearer or a kill-entailing use is found, downgrade the collective-military-rout nucleus to a contextual reading and re-open toward a broader 'defeat/break' nucleus or a multi-class result; if killing proves bundled, retract the 'not annihilation' boundary.

reopen_conditions: A newly confirmed hzm occurrence whose patient/subject is an individual, an inanimate object, or a non-military abstraction (breaking the collective-fighting-force distributional boundary held across 2:251 -hum, 38:11 jund, 54:45 al-jam`).

An occurrence where hzm bundles killing/annihilation into itself rather than holding it distinct as 2:251 does with qatala, or where the routed are shown destroyed rather than fleeing as in 54:45 (wa-yuwalluna al-dubur) — either would collapse the 'rout not slaughter' boundary.
Any Quran-internal evidence that decisively separates 'rout/put-to-flight' from generic 'defeat', resolving the residual under-determination between them and warranting a narrowing or a scope change.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The 'destroy/annihilate' rival was refuted internally (2:251 separates qatala; 54:45 shows fleeing survivors), and the lexicalized-participle and human-vs-divine-agent split hypotheses both failed. Distinctiveness is demonstrated Quran-internally via the qatala contrast (2:251) and the wallu al-dubur self-gloss (54:45); no occurrence resists the nucleus. Grade is capped at MODERATE by narrow monothematic breadth (N=3), not by any refutation.
